block.hotdeposit.hot_deposit.tooltip: Right-click to deposit matching inventory items into nearby storage (same as Shift + '). Its eyes open when you have something to deposit.
hotdeposit.configuration.title: Hot Deposit Config
hotdeposit.configuration.range.tooltip: How far (in blocks) from the Hot Deposit block to look for storage. Sophisticated Item Actions' own range is 10.
hotdeposit.configuration.blacklist.toolt: Storages the Hot Deposit block never deposits into. Use a block or entity id (minecraft:furnace, minecraft:armor_stand), a whole mod (somemod:*), or a tag (#c:chests).
